description: Implementation of the FunctionsEGL class for managing EGL function pointers and extensions in the ANGLE project, including initialization, extension handling, and wrapper methods.

classes.name: FunctionsEGL
classes.description: Manages EGL function pointers, extension loading, and provides wrapper methods for EGL operations.

classes.name: FunctionsGLEGL
classes.description: Derived class from FunctionsGL that uses FunctionsEGL to load OpenGL functions via EGL.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads EGL function pointers, initializes EGL display, checks version, and loads extensions.

methods.name: makeFunctionsGL
methods.description: Creates a FunctionsGL instance that uses this FunctionsEGL for loading OpenGL functions.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific EGL extension is supported.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the last EGL error code.

methods.name: chooseConfig
methods.description: Chooses an EGL configuration based on attribute list.

methods.name: getConfigAttrib
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value for a given EGL configuration.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes an EGL surface and context current.

methods.name: queryString
methods.description: Queries a string extension or info from EGL.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture image to a surface.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases a texture image from a surface.

methods.name: clientWaitSyncKHR
methods.description: Waits for an EGL sync object.

methods.name: getSyncAttribKHR
methods.description: Gets attributes of an EGL sync object.

methods.name: waitSyncKHR
methods.description: Waits on an EGL sync object.

methods.name: presentationTimeANDROID
methods.description: Sets presentation time for a surface.

methods.name: getCompositorTimingSupportedANDROID
methods.description: Checks if compositor timing is supported.

methods.name: getFrameTimestampSupportedANDROID
methods.description: Checks if frame timestamp is supported.
